◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."

💛 You hold Dispatcher's headset. You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

📺 "But real talk? The next act needs a BIGGER STAGE. I can't stage it with ONE fire — there's not enough of you to REFLECT, you feel me? Get me STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread. Rack up the kills, season your alliances, or feast like legends. Make it worth escalating."

📺 The Iron Pantry. An alien vault-lock on a full pantry. Five tumblers, one hour of air. Pick it and the village eats. Jam it and the cameras watch you starve politely.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A vault door the size of weather. Behind a glass panel: a full pantry — grain, smoked meat, winter itself, stacked and lit like a museum.

Five tumblers. One hour of air in the anteroom. The System, almost gentle: "PICK IT. EAT. THE CAMERAS LOVE HUNGER."

📺 The Alibi Chain. Five villagers, each vouched for by the next, a chain that ends at midnight. One link is false. Break the chain before the chain breaks the village.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

The chain, read aloud:

Carmen vouches for Puka. Puka vouches for Hind. Hind vouches for Naran. Naran vouches for Fatima.

One of those vouches is a lie. The System: "FIND THE FALSE LINK BEFORE MIDNIGHT. THE VILLAGE SLEEPS UNDER WHATEVER YOU LEAVE STANDING."

📺 RATINGS SUMMONS — the numbers are soft and the System is nervous.
📺 ● LIVE — Ratings Summons. YOU is on television.

📺 The brief: a promo stunt, live, sixty seconds, for the ratings. The System suggests interpretive dance about the food supply. The chat suggests worse.

Your body is the budget. Your dignity is the marketing spend.
📈 your showbiz fans +3 — ratings stunt (favor: 35)

📺 The silence deepens. It starts reading — your voice, speaking your thoughts a half-second before you think them.

The village hears the rehearsal thoughts first. Then it starts reaching deeper.

Nobody who's been in the room will say what it does. The village's veterans just shake their heads and won't meet your eyes.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
